headline: Mexico 2026 Growth Outlook Improves in Banxico and Citi Surveys
summary: Median economic forecasts in surveys conducted by Banxico and Citi have risen, with 2027 growth projected near 1.9% and year-end inflation anticipated just under 4%.
why: Central bank and private consensus economic forecasts provide key visibility for macroeconomic trends, monetary policy direction, and fixed-income investments in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Improved growth forecasts signal strengthening domestic economic activity.
